## GitHub review comments: `gh api .../pulls/279/comments`

```text
[1;38m{[m
[1;34m"body"[m[1;38m:[m [32m"**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Authenticate the manifest authority before issuing credentials**\n\nFor a direct/manual `workflow_dispatch`, both `manifest_base64` and `manifest_sha256` are caller-supplied, so this check proves only that two caller-controlled values agree. A dispatch can pair task A's inputs with a self-authored manifest and its matching digest—or with task B's manifest—and the generic validator never compares the manifest's task, writer, or limits with the workflow inputs or `coding_tasks`; the job then issues LiteLLM credentials and enforces the caller-selected path boundary. Retrieve or cryptographically attest the stored digest through a trusted server/issuer and bind it to `task_id` and `agent` before credential issuance.\n\nUseful? React with 👍 / 👎."[m[1;38m,[m
[1;34m"html_url"[m[1;38m:[m [32m"https://github.com/mryfmo/ai-ops-platform/pull/279#discussion_r3887869224"[m[1;38m,[m

[1;34m"path"[m[1;38m:[m [32m".github/workflows/coding-task.yml"[m
[1;38m}[m
[1;38m{[m
[1;34m"body"[m[1;38m:[m [32m"**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Emit a schema-valid digest-failure artifact**\n\nWhen the digest is missing or mismatched, the uploaded `codex-review-findings.json` cannot be consumed as a `review-artifact.schema.json` artifact: `status` is forbidden by `additionalProperties: false`, while required fields such as `task_id`, `reviewer`, `reviewed_dimensions`, and `collection` are absent. Consequently the advertised critical machine finding is uploaded but rejected by any contract-validating consumer; either emit the normal schema shape or define and use a separate failure-artifact contract.\n\nUseful? React with 👍 / 👎."[m[1;38m,[m
```
